obligations.expected_behavior: Provide bidirectional Exact Cover between every Atomic Obligation and its assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.
forbidden_result: An Atomic Obligation lacks bidirectional Exact Cover to any required assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, or runtime evidence.
A required assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence relationship is only one-way.
obligations.observable_result: Exact-Cover evaluation can trace each Atomic Obligation to and from its assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.
obligations.state_after: Every Atomic Obligation participates in bidirectional Exact Cover with the required artifact categories.
obligations.state_before: Bidirectional Exact Cover for every Atomic Obligation is not established by this requirement.
obligations.subject: Every Atomic Obligation
obligations.trigger: When Exact Cover is compiled or evaluated

obligations.expected_behavior: Ensure the Exact-Cover relationship graph contains no orphan nodes.
forbidden_result: Any assertion, selector, command, witness, runtime-evidence item, or Atomic Obligation is orphaned from the Exact-Cover graph.
obligations.observable_result: Exact-Cover evaluation reports no orphan nodes.
obligations.state_after: The Exact-Cover relationship graph has no orphan nodes.
obligations.state_before: The requirement does not establish that the Exact-Cover relationship graph is free of orphan nodes.
obligations.subject: Exact-Cover relationship graph
obligations.trigger: When Exact Cover is compiled or evaluated
